Reported 2026-09-25 by design-system lead d04c2baa; Ryan sees it on every Stop in that session: 'Cannot find module .../design-system/.bytedesk/agent-orchestration/agents/d04c2baa/.claude/helpers/graft-hooks.cjs'. design-system/.claude/settings.local.json has a Stop hook 'node "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/helpers/graft-hooks.cjs" stop' (from the external graft CLI); the file exists at the repo root. Verified by reading at 25bd49b: topology/lib/tmux.mjs:66, 89 and 108 start every standing-agent pane with -c <agent directory> and never set CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; this lead's own session (fd2b831f) shows it unset. management.mjs:52 already passes the repo root for its internal tm calls. Affects every hook or tool that treats CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR as the project root, for every standing agent in every enrolled repo. Open question the fix must settle by observation: whether Claude Code honours a CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR exported before launch or sets its own value from the launch directory when it runs hooks. If it overrides, exporting the variable is not enough and launch has to change (for example start in the repo root and keep the per-agent directory for notes and memory by other means).
